_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score remains in the Anxiety band, and no clear breaker has emerged to shift the phase, so HOLD is the statistically honest default.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on phase but differ on signal and confidence
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear and greed holds 45-55 and BTC 30d change stays inside -8% to +5%
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear and greed breaks below 40 or ETF flows rebound with F&G pushing above 60
